subject: Emotions
title: Empathy Fatigue
description: Learn Empathy Fatigue in one minute.

hook.text: A therapist stops feeling anything for her clients. After 10 years of absorbing pain, her empathy tank is empty.

buildup.text: Charles Figley called it 'compassion fatigue'—the cost of caring too much for too long without replenishment.

discovery.text: It's distinct from burnout. Compassion fatigue is specifically about absorbing others' trauma into your own body.

twist.text: The most empathic people are most vulnerable. Their strength becomes their liability—feeling too much, for too many.

climax.text: Prevention means shifting from empathy (feeling with) to compassion (caring for). Compassion activates reward, not pain.

punchline.text: Caring deeply isn't sustainable. Caring wisely is.

quiz.question: What differs compassion fatigue from burnout?
options: It's about absorbing others' trauma specifically
